**Not in this slice:** persisting marks, changing the range rule s285 set, or a mark column.

## Why

s285's marks are session-only and keyed by item. When a marked item becomes done or retired while the TUI is open, the request overlay still names it. The `[x]` marker also overwrites only three cells of the queue-number slot, so a four-digit number leaves a digit visible.
